_comment: Wine ferrari recreation — FINAL per-shot config locked after iterative review.
_iterations: v3 — 8 shots tuned individually based on shot-by-shot user feedback

1._note: Side push-in. Pure zoom, parallax off. 1.5x = 5.25% zoom (more visible than 3.5% baseline).

2._note: Rear-3/4 yaw right. Smooth = baseline motion + no parallax. Wide shot, parallax looks unnatural here.

3._note: Wing macro ECU. ONLY shot with strong parallax — large clean depth gradient. 1.5x motion + 4x perspective parallax sells the camera arc over the badge.

4._note: Direct rear. ty -8 -> -14 (modest upward boost, ~75% more than baseline). NO parallax to keep wing rails razor-sharp. Slightly more upward feel without depth-cliff distortion.

5._note: Direct front. Slightly exaggerated motion (1.25x) over baseline. No parallax. Pure zoom + tiny tilt up.

6._note: Front bonnet detail. Smooth — baseline motion, no parallax. Earlier 'hybrid' was too much.

7._note: Front-3/4 hero. Smooth — locked-off feel. Subtle 5px pan + tiny push, no parallax.

8._note: Front wheel close-up. Smooth — already 22px pan at baseline (largest in video), no parallax to avoid wheel-edge artifacts.
